name: What is the purpose of baseboards in a home?

mainEntity.name: What is the purpose of baseboards in a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baseboards serve both functional and aesthetic purposes in a home. Functionally, they protect the bottom of walls from damage due to furniture, vacuums, and foot traffic. Aesthetically, they create a finished look where the wall meets the floor, covering any gaps and providing a visual transition. Choosing the right style can significantly enhance a room's overall design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Baseboards protect walls from damage and provide a finished look where the wall meets the floor, covering gaps.
